name: Dorm Room Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as Dorm Room Fund (dormroomfund.com, 'DRF'), the student-run pre-seed fund First Round Capital started on Penn's campus in 2012 and that went independent with Fund IV in 2022; its own site describes writing the first check for founders still in school or just out, run by student investment partners plus a full-time team (Molly Fowler, Madison Jacox). Not First Round Capital itself, and not a university-run student fund or a scout program.

thesis_text.value: Writes the first check, often the first money in, for companies founded by current students and recent alumni (generally up to two years after graduating, including grad students, MBAs and PhDs) and by its own alumni network. Student investment partners on campuses source and pitch deals regionally, backed by a small full-time team; generalist across enterprise, developer tools, hardware, health, fintech, consumer and climate.
